fact: Tika 把蜂蜜抹在 Mearna 从脚踝到膝盖的咬伤抓痕上，再用煮过的 burdock 叶包扎
anchor: Tika was smoothing honey onto the many cuts, scrapes, and bitemarks that crisscrossed Mearna’s legs

fact: Mearna 抱怨营地 a fortnight 前才扎下，自己刚被 goblins 咬得遍体鳞伤
anchor: We only set up camp here a fortnight ago, harper.

fact: Flann 只召了少数人上 High Oak 开会，宣布全队北迁至 Drochbor Bridge 附近的 Mullachi Hills
anchor: Near the Drochbor Bridge, in the Mullachi Hills.

fact: Flann 命 Diarban 在一天内找齐所有可信、会弄乐器的人，且只要男人
anchor: I want you to find all the trustworthy men who can at least make passible sounds with an instrument.

fact: Flann 要 Mearna 找出用铁胆染过的 broadcloth，让女人们缝 at least two dozen 件 tabard
anchor: I want you and the other women to sew up at least two dozen tabards.

fact: Aedonite 修士 Brother Edgar 会吹 twin-pipe，并供出 Mud Boy 与 Silent Sherdan 也会乐器
anchor: I can play a little on the twin-pipe. My uncle taught me.

fact: Diarban 最终凑出四人：Sherdan、Mud Boy、Pooley One-Eye 与 Brother Edgar
anchor: I have located four who have at least some knowledge of the musical art

fact: Flann 改派 Mearna 明日随他回 Crannhyr，其余人去新营，Anitul-month 初会合，并要带上巨人 Long Liam
anchor: Afterward, we will meet the others at the new camp at the beginning of Anitul-month.
